backend/main.mo: Motoko canister storing per-user liquidity lines and boxes with CRUD-style methods and queries for candles and indicators.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing liquidity‑related feature IDs, referenced files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of all frontend files describing their purpose and behavior.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind/OKLCH styling variables and theme rules for light/dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML template mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component wrapping the app in ThemeProvider and rendering LiquidityMapperPage with notifications.
Monthly BTC candlestick chart using Recharts with custom tooltip, candle shapes, and liquidity overlays.
frontend/src/components/ChartStates.tsx: Reusable loading, error, and empty‑state components for chart data fetch flows.
frontend/src/features/data/fetchUtils.ts: Fetch helpers with timeout handling, errors, validation, and JSON parsing for market data requests.
frontend/src/features/data/types.ts: Defines the Candle interface and functions to normalize Binance and CoinGecko OHLC data into Candle objects.
frontend/src/features/data/useMonthlyCan: Fetches BTC monthly candles with Binance as primary source and CoinGecko as fallback, exposing the result via a React Query hook.
frontend/src/features/liquidity/diagnost: Provides development-only logging utilities for debugging liquidity detection, including reversal structures and box creation.
frontend/src/features/liquidity/fixtures: Generates a candle fixture simulating a reversal sequence used to reproduce missing lower liquidity zone issues.
Runs development-only regression tests validating lower box creation, persistence, and clearing logic in the liquidity model.
frontend/src/features/liquidity/liquidit: Implements liquidity detection logic including reversal structure detection, box creation, lifecycle evaluation, and related helpers.
frontend/src/features/liquidity/types.ts: Defines types for liquidity lines, boxes, completed zones, and related constants used by the liquidity model.
frontend/src/features/liquidity/useLiqui: React hook that computes the liquidity model and merges it with persisted boxes while enforcing state invariants.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, handling identity loading, login, and logout states.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a React Query hook that fetches monthly candle data from the backend actor when available.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining the app’s dark theme, color variables, utility classes, and responsive tweaks.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/LiquidityMapperPage.t: Renders the BTC Liquidity Mapper page, showing monthly candles with loading/error/empty states and a styled layout.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, radius, utilities, and plugin setup for the project.
project_state.json: Describes the project’s state, architecture notes, known issues, and existing feature definitions for the BTC liquidity mapping app.
